Peninsular Petroleum Corporation 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Uttar Pradesh · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/45/2024/011 
 Dated: March 31, 2026 
 
 CertifiCate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Institutional Building - Uttar Pradesh Pkg-11"
 
 (buildings), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN
 NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on October 8, 2024 at a gross executed value
 
 of INR 24.05 Cr (Rupees 24.05 Crore Only). 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
 
 satisfactory completion of the final inspection. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Amit Mukherjee. This certificate is issued
 for record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to
 establish past performance. 
 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Peninsular Petroleum Corporation
